description: Get one expiration's positioning from the live chain: open interest and volume by side with put/call ratios, max pain, at-the-money implied volatility, the at-the-money straddle's mid as a market-implied expected move, 25-delta skew, the strikes with the most unsigned gamma, and the contracts trading heaviest against their open interest. Defaults to the nearest upcoming expiration. A figure that needs the whole chain or one open-interest date is withheld. Nothing here is a forecast, and gamma carries no dealer sign. Plus reads delayed indicative quotes, Pro real-time; the Free plan is answered with an upgrade note. US tickers only.

expiration.description: Expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: nearest upcoming)
